_about: Single source of a Wave model page's public facts. Build input only: not shipped. Pages render from it via {{card:<model>.<item>}} tokens (web/scripts/model-cards.mjs), so a number appears in exactly one place. Every measured item carries the R-number of web-external RESULTS-MATRIX.md and the date it was measured; ranges are published as ranges. Facts come only from the lab's UI handoff of 2026-10-20 and the release READMEs it names. To add a model page (Giga is next, when the lab supplies its facts): add an entry here with its page slug and status tier, build the page from the tokens, and add it to the Research menu, Models and status and the Wave family page; test/model-pages.test.mjs then holds it to the same rules. Status words (stage, band) are NOT here: they render from wave-status.json.

models.name: Wave Pico
models.author: RogerAI Labs
purpose: Reads one industrial telemetry channel at a time: Modbus registers, Sparkplug B, Prometheus, InfluxDB line protocol, Datadog series, syslog and feature summaries.
Names the instrument fault (stuck, dropout, noisy, drifting, railed, or none) or the process state the channel is in.
Answers only when its own confidence clears a measured gate. Below the gate it escalates, and an escalation is a record, not an answer.
